tiers.note: head-counts read bare on ULTRA MEGA: the solo sheet's own numbers (the client's count helper skips the raid curve's ×1.8 at this tier), ×6.61 for a ten-seat night

damageLaw: Three kinds of hit. HP hits (the sprinter, the pterodactyl, the triceratops, the bruiser, the dilophosaurus from MEDIUM up) grow with the tier (15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 65 HP for a bite, double for a slam) and land at 50 % off the man's sheet HP (the damper, below); a fresh man with no more HP than the hit lands is KO'd in one. KO hits (the stegosaurus' boulder, King Rex's bite) take him out whatever his HP. Bar hits (the spitter's glob, the king's fire, hop and tail, the dilophosaurus on EASY) take a share of his bar of 5–7 bar hits at level 20 (8 at rank 100, more for the saber Sarge and the heroes), each landing at 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP since v28.65; a man who takes no hit for 4 s mends. Since v29.17 the damper lands every HP hit and bar hit an enemy makes on your men, Sarge, a hero or a vehicle at 50 % in the campaign and the boss fights (50 % off on every tier, a row in the Boss Lab's RULES); a KO is still a KO. Since v29.51 (THE MINIONS SOAK) every dinosaur's body from EASY to MEGA is a set number of rounds of your rifleman at your commander level (the lab: level 20); the dinosaurs' hits are as they were.
headlines: Since v28.65 the dinosaurs' damage changes with difficulty: the sprinter's bite, the pterodactyl's dive and the triceratops' charge hit for 15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 65 HP (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA), the bruiser's slam for double (30 · 60 · 90 · 120 · 130 HP), and the dilophosaurus burns 50 HP a second from MEDIUM up (90 on ULTRA MEGA; 1 bar hit a beat on EASY). The stegosaurus' boulder and King Rex's bite are still a KO. Since v29.17 every hit but those KOs lands on your men at 50 % (the damper).

Body HP: the triceratops went 12 → 36 and the dilophosaurus 7 → 21 at the base, so every tier's bodies are three times as tough; since v29.51 (THE MINIONS SOAK) a body on EASY to MEGA is a set number of rounds of your rifleman at your commander level instead (a triceratops 30 · 45 · 60 · 75 rounds: 69 · 103 · 138 · 172 HP at the lab's level 20; a sprinter 2 · 3 · 4 · 5: 5 · 7 · 9 · 11 HP); ULTRA MEGA's guard trikes are 570 HP.

THE BOSS LAB fights King Rex at level 20 on every tier: Sarge with the saber, the scout jeep and 9 men at rank 20 (rifleman, M. gunner, bazooka, mortar, medic, flame, sweeper, radio man, grenadier). A bite lands 7.5 · 15 · 22.5 · 30 · 32.5 HP (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA, the damper's 50 %): one bite KOs no stock man on EASY, the rifleman, mortar, medic, sweeper and radio man from MEDIUM (and the spy, a tap away), the grenadier from HARD and the M. gunner from MEGA; the bazooka, flame and commando live through it on every tier.

A slam lands 15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 65 HP: one slam KOs the rifleman, mortar, medic, sweeper and radio man from EASY (and the spy, a tap away), the M. gunner and grenadier from MEDIUM, the bazooka from HARD (and the commando, a tap away) and the flame from MEGA. One dilophosaurus breath (2 beats) lands 25 · 25 · 25 · 45 HP (MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA): it KOs the rifleman, M. gunner, mortar, medic, sweeper, radio man and grenadier from MEDIUM (and the spy, a tap away) and the bazooka on ULTRA MEGA (and the commando, a tap away); the flame lives through it on every tier.

The king's fire (10 bar hits a beat, landing at 50 %): at level 20 two beats KO every man of the army but the saber Sarge (3) and the Claymore Sarge (5); on ULTRA MEGA (100 a beat) one beat KOs every man and hero but King Yeti (2), King Rex (2), King Croak (3) and Emperor Bear (2).

Bar hits (the campaign's hit counter): a level-20 man's bar is 5 to 7 bar hits; one bar hit is about a sixth of his HP (2.2 HP of a rifleman's 14, 8.3 of a flame's 55); since v28.65 a bar hit lands at 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP, and since v29.17 at 50 % of that from an enemy (the damper).

King Rex's bars with one commander: court 790 · 1,009 · 1,507 · 4,185 · 15,000, angry 790 · 1,098 · 1,651 · 4,586 · 15,000 (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA); on EASY to MEGA each extra commander adds 0.9 of the solo bar; ULTRA MEGA is flat for any party since v29.45.

changes.what: The sprinter's bite, the pterodactyl's dive and the triceratops' charge stop being KOs: they hit for 15 · 30 · 45 · 60 · 65 HP on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA · ULTRA MEGA. The bruiser's slam hits for double (30 · 60 · 90 · 120 · 130 HP). The dilophosaurus burns 50 HP a second on MEDIUM, HARD and MEGA and 90 on ULTRA MEGA (EASY as before: 1 bar hit a beat). The boulder and King Rex's bite stay KOs.

Body HP ×3: triceratops 12 → 36 HP and dilophosaurus 7 → 21 HP at the base, so every tier's body is three times as tough until v29.51 (since THE MINIONS SOAK a body on EASY to MEGA is a set number of rounds of your rifleman instead: the CARD-SOK row) (the ULTRA MEGA guard's trikes 570 HP).

ONE HP NUMBER: your man's HP is the number on his unit sheet in every mode (the same one the battleground uses). The older hits that count in bar hits (the spitter, the king's fire, his hop and tail) land a little lighter on tough men: 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP of a hit.
THE CLUTCH: every clutch (the eruption's nests, the last eruption) lands one egg every 0.2 s a nest, side by side, each still hatching on its old moment.

TENTH-RANK HP (with CARD-LRB): extra HP every 10 ranks: M. gunner +1, bazooka +10, grenadier +4, flame +6, commando +10, spy +1. At level 20 the flame and the commando have 55 HP and lived through a MEDIUM bite with 25 HP until the damper (no class did on Oct 30).
THE BOMBER: your bomber flies in every boss fight now and aims at the thickest knot of dinos (or the king). Price and damage unchanged.
KING CROAK, YOUR HERO: King Croak on your side is tougher: his bar starts at 131 (was 31), and at level 20 he stands with 169 HP and a bar of 146 (the heroes' rows of WHO SURVIVES).

THE DAMPER: every enemy blow on your men lands at 50 % in the campaign and the boss fights (50 % off on every tier, a row in the Boss Lab's RULES): a 15 HP bite lands 7.5, the king's fire beat 5 of its 10 bar hits; a KO (the boulder, King Rex's bite) is still a KO. A man stands about twice the blows he did, and WHO SURVIVES and THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES count it.

READ AGAIN ON v29.51 after the day's cards: King Rex's bars for one commander on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD follow the designers' time-to-kill chart (CARD-RXT, v29.37: the court 790 · 1,009 · 1,507, the angry return 790 · 1,098 · 1,651) and on MEGA the player-damage-threshold pass's number (CARD-PDT: 4,185 · 4,586); the men's tenth-rank HP moved (CARD-FLT, v29.40: the flame's rungs through level 50 tripled; CARD-DHP, v29.41: the bazooka's and commando's doubled): at level 20 the flame 55 HP, the bazooka 33, the commando 41. WHO SURVIVES and THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES count it.

ULTRA MEGA HP: King Rex's two bars are flat for any party on ULTRA MEGA: 15,000 the court and 15,000 the angry return with one commander and with ten (each extra commander added 0.9 of the solo bar there before). EASY to MEGA keep the party law.

THE MINIONS SOAK: from EASY to MEGA every dinosaur's body is a set number of rounds of your rifleman at your commander level (the Boss Lab: its level 20; a party of two or more: level 35, 75 on MEGA): a sprinter 2 · 3 · 4 · 5, a pterodactyl 2 · 3 · 4 · 5, a spitter 4 · 6 · 8 · 10, an egg 3 · 4 · 6 · 8, a bruiser 12 · 18 · 24 · 30, a triceratops 30 · 45 · 60 · 75, a stegosaurus 10 · 15 · 20 · 25, a dilophosaurus 20 · 30 · 40 · 50 rounds (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA). One round of a level-20 rifleman is 2.29 HP, so at the lab's level the bodies are a sprinter 5 · 7 · 9 · 11 HP (was 1 · 1 · 2 · 2), a pterodactyl 5 · 7 · 9 · 11 HP (was 2 · 3 · 4 · 5), a spitter 9 · 14 · 18 · 23 HP (was 5 · 8 · 11 · 13), an egg 7 · 9 · 14 · 18 HP (was 4 · 6 · 9 · 11), a bruiser 28 · 41 · 55 · 69 HP (was 12 · 18 · 26 · 32), a triceratops 69 · 103 · 138 · 172 HP (was 36 · 54 · 79 · 95), a stegosaurus 23 · 34 · 46 · 57 HP (was 10 · 15 · 22 · 26), a dilophosaurus 46 · 69 · 92 · 115 HP (was 21 · 32 · 46 · 55) (the 'was' is the dashboard's read of v29.45); an egg's hatchling is born with the same number, and so are the eruption's pours and clutches. ULTRA MEGA keeps the night's own bodies (the ×0.25 / ×0.5 and the king's guard). The dinosaurs' hits are as they were: this card gives them staying power, not teeth. The cells live in the Boss Lab's RULES (two rows for the lair: the rounds and the party's level), editable there like every rule.

questions.text: "Rosaya" is read as Raziya (the boss designer) and the page says "for Raziya".

Yesterday's appendix (the other seven fights' attack rows, from the v28.42 research) is gone from this edition. It is stale, and the Ice Castle changed today. Every fight gets its own live page instead, King Croak and King Yeti next.

questions.text: "Level 20" is the Boss Lab's own King Rex level and stock army. THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES table covers every rank. Should another reference level stand beside it (for example the campaign level where players first meet the lair)?

A balance read for Raziya, not a bug: at the lab's level 20, one bite from MEDIUM up and one slam on any tier KO almost every man. Only the flame and the commando (31 HP) live through a MEDIUM bite, with 1 HP. LRB-Q6 flagged the same.
"Bar hits" is the page's word for the campaign's hit counter, so the team never reads the code's old name for it.

THE KO PASS: the strikes that KO today would hit for EASY 32 · MEDIUM 32 · HARD 32 · MEGA 32 · ULTRA MEGA 32 HP by tier (the lab's level 20 · 20 · 20 · 20 · 20), the top of the window EASY 25 to 32 · MEDIUM 25 to 32 · HARD 25 to 32 · MEGA 25 to 32 · ULTRA MEGA 25 to 32: the hardest hit that leaves every heavy standing, with the weakest (the BAZOOKA everywhere) at 1 HP. The bottom of the window leaves him 8 HP and lets no lesser man stand either.
questions.rec: the top, as Wyatt framed it (high, not enough to defeat a heavy); say the bottom if the BAZOOKA should keep a cushion.

questions.text: THE DAMPER (since v29.17) lets 50 % of every enemy hit land on your men; a KO is not dampened today, a numbered hit would be. On EASY the proposed 32 is written in the game at 64 to land 32, or at 32 set to land in full. Written over the damper, the number moves when the damper moves: with 30 % off (the damper's first take) the 64 would land 44.8 on the BAZOOKA (33 HP) and fell him.
questions.rec: set the numbered strikes to land in full, so each number holds whatever the damper is set to; say so if they should ride the damper like every other hit.

notes: A unit's HP is the body the sheet fields on that tier, as the game spawns it (measured in the proof). ULTRA MEGA wears the night's ×0.25 / ×0.5 on the swarm, and the king's guard (the trikes and the bruisers the sheet pins) keeps the full bar: for those two the HP shown is the guard's bar and the small "swarm" number under it the swarm's / a hatched egg's body (the unit's note says how many of the sheet's bodies are the guard). The head-count is the bodies named in the solo wave sheet (one commander), eggs counted as eggs and hatching into more; ULTRA MEGA's counts are the bare sheet, ×6.61 for a ten-seat night.

WHO SURVIVES counts hits of that strike in a row (inside the 4 s mend) that KO a fresh man at the lab's level 20 (KO = one hit), each hit landing at 50 % since the damper (v29.17); the dilo's fire breath counts beats (2 a breath), and so does the king's fire breath. A dot in a cell's corner marks a man the proof hit on the real machines (Chrome for Testing + WebKit); the other cells are the read's arithmetic.

THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES ONE HIT is the lowest rank (0–100) at which a fresh man's sheet HP is more than one hit as it lands (50 % of it since the damper; no gifts, soul or gear); for the dilo's fire breath the hit is one whole breath (2 beats); never = not by rank 100. Sarge's rows read the iron at the same rank as the man.

The king's HP per tier is his court bar with one commander, and the second number under it the angry return's; THE BOSS shows both bars (THE COURT · THE ANGRY RETURN) by the number of commanders (1 · 2 · 3 · 4 · 5 · 10) as the game builds the sheet; on ULTRA MEGA the sheet reads the same two numbers at every party size since v29.45 (CARD-UMH).

The lab's army (the line under the fight's name) is the Boss Lab's own seats, one of each class in THE PLATOON at the lab's level, read out of the lab after its launch on every tier, with the iron Sarge wears; the spy and the commando are a tap away.

A picture over 60 KB as the game encodes it is carried re-encoded when that fits (the same drawing): KING CROAK as a hero on your side. Still over the cap, it is a PNG of the same sprite, 240 px tall or the largest of 180/140 that fits: SPRINTER (47 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 167 KB SVG), SPITTER (46 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 80 KB SVG), BRUISER (47 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 157 KB SVG), KING REX (52 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 105 KB SVG), KING REX as a hero on your side (52 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 105 KB SVG), EMPEROR BEAR as a hero on your side (50 KB PNG, 240 px tall, for a 274 KB SVG), PRINCESS CROAK as a hero on your side (39 KB PNG, 180 px tall, for a 297 KB SVG). Dropped: none.

rows.t: A proposal (Nov 1, 2026, re-read Nov 2, 2026 with THE DAMPER), nothing in the game has changed. Since v29.17 THE DAMPER lets 50 % of every enemy hit land on your men; a KO is not dampened today, a numbered hit would be, so the number written in the game is the proposed hit over that share (or the strike is set to land in full). The game fells a man whose HP reaches 0, so a hit equal to his HP fells him and one under it leaves him standing; the three heavies are Wyatt's list; HP is each man's at the lab's level for the tier, as the page read it. A man a strike never fells today, or fells by bar hits (a Sarge with a blade up, the riot shield, the snowball bouncers), keeps that rule.
